query:
SELECT 
  DATE(saleDate) as data,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(finalAmount) as valor_total
FROM sales 
WHERE saleType = 'DELIVERY'
GROUP BY DATE(saleDate)
ORDER BY data DESC
LIMIT 10;
